channel.title: CNA's Blog
channel.description: Building a portable XNA-style framework for the long term.

item.title: How to Build CNA and Use It in Your Own Projects
item.description: A practical guide to building CNA, integrating it into a C++23 project, selecting graphics renderers, handling content, and targeting Linux, Windows, macOS, the Web, Android and iOS.

item.title: 91 XNA Samples Ported to C++ with CNA
item.description: Ninety-one Microsoft XNA samples have been ported to C++23 with CNA, validated on Linux and the Web, and collected in a playable browser gallery.

item.title: Island Simulator
item.description: Island Simulator is a first-person tropical island exploration, swimming and driving experience built with CNA.

item.title: Train Simulator
item.description: Train Simulator is a first-person passenger experience following a six-car electric train across a deterministic 286.4-kilometre railway.

item.title: Car Simulator
item.description: Car Simulator is a CNA-based passenger-car driving experience set across a fictional Czech town, villages, countryside and forest.

item.title: Room Simulator
item.description: Room Simulator is a CNA reference scene that combines a furnished living room, an exterior street, changing daylight, weather and reflections.

item.title: Backrooms Simulator
item.description: Backrooms Simulator is a deterministic, effectively unbounded first-person exploration game built with C++23 and CNA.

item.title: School Simulator
item.description: School Simulator is a large first-person CNA school with 748 rooms, a full timetable and up to thousands of simulated occupants.

item.title: Museum Simulator
item.description: Museum Simulator is a ten-floor first-person CNA museum whose 295 exhibit rooms turn framework APIs into interactive displays.

item.title: CNA Demos
item.description: CNA Demos is a searchable catalog of focused, executable examples that also doubles as an automated compatibility and regression suite for CNA.

item.title: FX support in CNA
item.description: CNA can load and execute compiled XNA/FNA Effect Framework binaries across six renderer families, while keeping legacy FX separate from ShaderEffect.

item.title: How is CNA Tested
item.description: CNA is a large compatibility and graphics project.

item.title: CNA vs FNA vs MonoGame vs XNA 4.0 (original)
item.description: XNA 4.0, FNA, MonoGame and CNA share one programming model, but CNA now serves both native C++ and original C# games through CNA.NET.

item.title: Consoles and CNA
item.description: CNA is designed as a portable game framework, but there is one major category of gaming hardware it does not currently support: game consoles.

item.title: Operating Systems supported by CNA
item.description: CNA targets Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS/iPadOS and the Web, with explicitly different levels of build, runtime and hardware evidence.

item.title: glTF support in CNA
item.description: glTF 2.0 is one of the most important modern interchange formats for real-time 3D content.

item.title: CNA Content Pipeline and the format CNB
item.description: Games rarely use their original source assets exactly as artists created them.

item.title: CNJ
item.description: CNJ, short for CNA Content JSON, is CNA's human-readable JSON-based content format.

item.title: XNA Pipeline in CNA
item.description: One of the most difficult parts of XNA compatibility is not rendering.

item.title: CNA Modules
item.description: CNA is a large framework, but it is not built as one giant C++ library.

item.title: xna4-spec
item.description: xna4-spec is a machine-readable specification of the Microsoft XNA 4.0 API.

item.title: CNA Extended
item.description: CNA Extended is a C++23 port of MonoGame.Extended designed to run on top of CNA.

item.title: CNA Examples
item.description: CNA Examples is an interactive catalog of demonstrations covering the CNA framework.

item.title: Mesh Craft
item.description: MeshCraft is a C++23 3D scene editor and content-authoring toolkit built around its own editable MC3 scene format.

item.title: CNA Cemetery
item.description: CNA Cemetery preserves projects moved out of CNA Lab, including their complete unsquashed Git subtree history.

item.title: Sharp Runtime
item.description: Sharp Runtime is a C++23 implementation of a practical subset of the .NET System.* libraries.

item.title: EasyGL
item.description: EasyGL is a toolkit-independent C++20 graphics library built on top of OpenGL and OpenGL ES.

item.title: Tamagotchi CNA
item.description: Tamagotchi CNA is an unfinished, independent C++ reimplementation of the international 1997 P1 virtual-pet program, presented through CNA.

item.title: Meta GL
item.description: MetaGL is a low-level, type-safe C++23 wrapper around the programmable OpenGL family.

item.title: Wolf CNA
item.description: Wolf CNA is an original C++23 retro first-person shooter that renders a polygonal 3D world through CNA.
